name: How long does new home plumbing installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does new home plumbing installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of new home plumbing installation varies depending on the size and complexity of the house, as well as coordination with other construction phases. The 'rough-in' phase, where main supply lines and drainage systems are installed before walls are closed, can take several days to a couple of weeks for an average home. The 'finish' phase, involving the installation of fixtures, appliances, and final connections, also takes several days. Overall, the plumbing portion of a new home build can span several weeks, interspersed with other construction activities. We work efficiently to stay on schedule without compromising quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: New home plumbing installation can take several weeks, including rough-in and finish phases, depending on home size and coordination.
